Definition: from G5448; (the act) completion, i.e. (of prophecy) verification, or (of expiation) absolution:--perfection, performance.
BiblicalUsage: The word is completion, perfection, fulfilment. The writer asks, if perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, what further need was there for another priest; and Elisabeth says, Blessed is she that believed, for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the law's priesthood could not bring completion, and the word to Mary was performed because she believed.
